scope: All 16 eligible training abstracts containing DATASET labels; whole source and all existing spans read. Only named DATASET/benchmark judgments concluded; TASK caveats are unresolved, not corrections.

documents.quote: a very high accuracy on the MNIST test set
documents.initialReason: MNIST is explicitly the named test set, not a model.
documents.selfReviewReason: The URL is excluded; the sole standalone MNIST mention is supported. CNN and ensemble components are separate METHODs.

documents.quote: Extensive experiments on the DIOR and NWPU VHR-10 datasets
documents.initialReason: Both coordinated benchmark names are explicit continuous DATASET spans.
documents.selfReviewReason: Do not absorb datasets into either name or confuse GE-FSOD/CFPAN/MRRPN with datasets.
documents.taskCaveat: The first Remote sensing object detection is a full TASK; the later remote sensing object detection is annotated only object detection. Maximal task modifier policy needs a separate source-wide review, not a prediction-driven edit.

documents.quote: Fashion-MNIST is intended to serve as a direct drop-in replacement for the original MNIST dataset
documents.initialReason: Two full Fashion-MNIST mentions and one original MNIST name are explicitly datasets.
documents.selfReviewReason: No nested MNIST entity inside Fashion-MNIST; URL mention excluded. All three existing DATASET spans remain supported.
documents.taskCaveat: benchmarking machine learning algorithms is a broad evaluation activity rather than a named downstream task; current TASK taxonomy needs explicit adjudication before changing this label.

documents.quote: On HumanEval, a new evaluation set we release
documents.initialReason: HumanEval is explicitly a named evaluation set.
documents.selfReviewReason: Codex/Copilot are not datasets. NER support for HumanEval does not resolve the production-version relationship attribution withdrawn in round41.

documents.quote: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD), a new reading comprehension dataset
documents.initialReason: The full dataset name and acronym are two source occurrences, not two independent datasets.
documents.selfReviewReason: Question Answering inside the dataset name is not a nested TASK; standalone reading comprehension is separate. No automatic alias merge is performed.

documents.quote: we introduce GSM8K, a dataset of 8.5K high quality linguistically diverse grade school math word problems
documents.initialReason: GSM8K is explicitly introduced as a dataset and occurs again in the result statement.
documents.selfReviewReason: Both occurrences retain the name only; grade school math word problems is not a second named dataset. Verification terms remain METHOD, not DATASET.

documents.quote: This paper introduces MMLU-Pro, an enhanced dataset
documents.initialReason: The long MMLU name, acronym and MMLU-Pro name are source-backed benchmarks. Preserve complete hyphenated names.
documents.selfReviewReason: All 14 occurrences are supported but correlated within one paper; the MMLU substring inside MMLU-Pro is not separately tagged. CoT/direct answering are methods.
documents.taskCaveat: language comprehension and reasoning is one contiguous coordinated TASK phrase under existing labels; this does not establish a universal split/merge rule for other coordinations.

documents.quote: we present SuperGLUE, a new benchmark styled after GLUE
documents.initialReason: Four standalone occurrences refer to benchmark suites, admitted by the current DATASET category.
documents.selfReviewReason: Do not tag GLUE nested inside SuperGLUE or infer a new dataset from the leaderboard URL. These repeated names are not independent papers.

documents.quote: We evaluate the performance of DNG class-removal on MNIST and CIFAR10
documents.initialReason: The two benchmark names are explicitly used in the reported evaluation.
documents.selfReviewReason: Keep literal CIFAR10 spelling; do not silently normalize to CIFAR-10 in a span. DNG/Stable Diffusion are methods.

documents.quote: we introduce CS-TDS, a tailored benchmark suite
documents.initialReason: CS-TDS is a named benchmark suite, unlike generic dataset references throughout the abstract.
documents.selfReviewReason: KATS is the system name, task-oriented dataset search is TASK; the word dataset alone is not DATASET. Preserve the CS-TDS hyphen.

documents.quote: on CelebAHQ-IDI, a dataset proposed for identity-preserving face inpainting
documents.initialReason: CelebAHQ-IDI is explicitly the named dataset; nearby task modifiers stay outside its span.
documents.selfReviewReason: MyStyle/Paint by Example/Custom Diffusion are compared techniques, not datasets, despite the word benchmarks. NER support does not itself prove EVALUATED_ON.

documents.quote: For action recognition on the UCF101 dataset
documents.initialReason: UCF101 is explicit; ImageNet is the dataset name in the pretrained-parameter provenance phrase.
documents.selfReviewReason: A DATASET mention of ImageNet does not imply this paper evaluated on ImageNet; preserve the separate NER/RE semantics. Skip-Clip is METHOD.

documents.quote: Evaluated on the ScanNet and SceneNN benchmarks
documents.initialReason: Both dataset names are explicitly reported as benchmarks.
documents.selfReviewReason: The unnamed our approach does not become a named METHOD endpoint merely because datasets are present. Existing NER names are supported, relation uncertainty remains.

documents.quote: including the QPLIB, Netlib LP and Maros-Meszaros problems
documents.initialReason: These are three named benchmark problem collections under the existing DATASET definition.
documents.selfReviewReason: OSQP/RLQP/QP solvers are methods; generic QP benchmarks is not a fourth dataset. Retain full Netlib LP and hyphenated Maros-Meszaros.

documents.initialReason: Meta-World is the named benchmark environment/suite under the current DATASET contract.
documents.selfReviewReason: tasks remains outside the name. Reward-model measurements cannot automatically be attributed to every CriticGPT occurrence; no RE changes here.

documents.quote: Extensive experiments on POPE, LLaVA-Bench (In-the-Wild), and MM-SafetyBench
documents.initialReason: All three named benchmarks are explicit; parentheses belong to the LLaVA variant name.
documents.selfReviewReason: HuggingFace is an ecosystem, not a dataset. The complete variant and hyphenated names should not be trimmed. SmoothGuard is METHOD.
documents.taskCaveat: Standalone reasoning in a generic MLLM capability clause may be broader than a concrete TASK. Resolve generic capability policy across train sources before any relabeling.
